summary: First-run end-to-end testing of Brilhantes Imóveis (sales control for a single gestor). Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passing covering auth (unauthenticated 401, cookie, bearer), sales listing with month/year filters, CRUD, installment baixa toggle (with persisted received_date), stats consistency (ja_entrou + falta_entrar ≈ total_vendido), ranking per broker, and 12-month series. Frontend: injected session cookie flow verified. /dashboard without session correctly redirects to '/' (login). With cookie, dashboard loads 13 seeded 2026 sales, all 5 KPIs render, monthly chart renders, ranking card toggles Por Volume/Por Quantidade, and month filter (Junho) correctly narrows the table to 4 June rows. Full 'Nova venda' flow passes: open dialog, fill fields, toggle parcelado, generate 3 installments, submit → sale appears; open 'Fluxo a receber' → 'Dar baixa' marks installment 1 as received; edit updates property_name; delete removes the sale.

issues: Recharts logs a transient 'width(-1) height(-1)' warning on first mount before ResponsiveContainer measures (cosmetic only; chart renders correctly thereafter).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_sales filters in Python after fetching all docs; for scale, push month/year filter into Mongo query using a regex or $expr on sale_date prefix.
SaleCreate.commission_value is accepted from client but could be re-derived server-side from sale_value*commission_rate to prevent client/server drift; currently commissao is trusted as sent.
update_sale builds 'updated' as merge but response model is Sale; it echoes the merged doc rather than re-fetching—fine but inconsistent with PATCH which re-fetches.
No validation that sum(installments.value) + entrada == sale_value; silent inconsistency possible.
Backend trusts client-sent installments on create/update without verifying unique 'number' values.
Dashboard uses react-query but no error boundaries/toasts on query failures (only mutations have toasts).
